text: What is the simplex category Δ?
choices: The category of all simplicial sets
The category whose objects are finite non-empty linearly ordered sets [n]={0,…,n} and morphisms are order-preserving maps
The full subcategory of Top on standard simplices
The nerve of the natural numbers
explanation: Δ has objects [n] = {0<1<…<n} and morphisms are order-preserving (weakly monotone) functions. Simplicial sets are presheaves on Δ.
